agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/sql.py NameAliasMixin.get_real_name(): an inverted condition (`if not (tok.match(T.Punctuation, '.'))`) caused the method to find the index of the last *non*-dot token instead of the last actual dot token, so get_real_name() returned the alias instead of the real object name for dotted identifiers with aliases (e.g. 'foo.bar baz', 'foo.bar AS baz'). This cascaded into 21 failing checks around identifier/alias/grouping behavior. Corrected the loop to track the index of the last dot token and resume name lookup right after it. Verified manually against plain identifiers, multi-level dotted names, dotted names with implicit/explicit aliases, and function calls with aliases -- all now produce correct real_name/alias/name results.
